question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**famous**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the fifth blank is 'famous'.
 
• The given passage is about the creation of superheroes in Indian comics. It mentions various characters and publishers who have contributed to the Indian comic book industry.
 
• The word "**famous**" is the correct choice here because it describes the popularity of Raj Comics' superheroes.
 
• The term "**famous**" means well-known or widely recognized, and in this context, it indicates that Nagraj, Tiranga, and Shakti are highly regarded and have a significant fan following in the comic book world.
 
• The other options, "**noted**", "**influential**", and "**good**", do not accurately describe the level of popularity and recognition of the Raj Comics' superheroes.
 
• "**Noted**" implies that they are recognized for their quality or uniqueness, but not necessarily for their popularity.
 
• "**Influential**" implies a level of impact, but not necessarily popularity. "**Good**" is a more general adjective and does not capture the specific idea of being well-known and widely recognized. 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

Correct *Passage*:__ *Comics have (1) __produced__ many superheroes. Bantul, the great was (2) __created__ in the year 1965 in the backdrop of the Indo-Pak war. Indrajal comics was set up in 1964 and (3) __employed__ Aabid Surti, who gave birth to a character called Bhadur in 1976 wearing kurta and jeans. Raj comics too (4) __entered__ into this sphere with their **(5) __famous__** toons Nagraj, Tiranga and Shakti together called Brahman Rakshak (protectors of the universe).*
